units.source_text: 这期间，在大阪的郊外，信子理应幸福的新家庭在大阪郊外安顿好了。

en.t: During this time, in the outskirts of Osaka, Nobuko's new household, which should have been happy, had settled down in the Osaka suburbs.

units.source_text: 他们的新房在幽静的松树林中，松树脂的香味，和煦的阳光——

en.t: Their new house stood in a quiet grove of pines, with the scent of pine resin and warm, gentle sunlight--

units.source_text: 当然，因为丈夫很少在家，租来的二层小楼虽然生机勃勃但是却过于安静。

en.t: Of course, because her husband was seldom at home, the rented two-story cottage, though full of life, was far too quiet.

units.source_text: 在安静的午后，信子经常觉得心情不好，

en.t: On quiet afternoons, Nobuko often felt low in spirits,

units.source_text: 每当心情低落的时候，她必定会从针线箱的抽屉里拿出整齐的叠在最下面的粉红色信笺。

en.t: and whenever her mood sank, she would invariably take from the drawer of her sewing box the pink letter paper neatly folded at the very bottom.

units.source_text: 信笺上用钢笔细细密密的写着：

en.t: On the letter paper, written densely and finely in pen, were the words:
